text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 大家好，欢迎收听《真实简单英语》。
zh_hant: 大家好，歡迎收聽《真實簡單英語》。

text: In this podcast, we help you understand
zh: 在这档播客里，我们帮你听懂
zh_hant: 在這檔播客裡，我們幫你聽懂

text: everyday English conversations.
I'm Neil.
And I'm Georgie.
Don't forget to go to our website to find a text version of this episode
zh: 别忘了访问我们的网站，找到本期节目的文字版
zh_hant: 別忘了訪問我們的網站，找到本期節目的文字版

text: to read along – bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi Georgie, how are you?
I'm great, thank you, Neil.
I just had a delicious lunch.
zh: 我刚吃了一顿美味的午饭。
zh_hant: 我剛吃了一頓美味的午飯。

text: Oh, nice.
What did you eat for lunch?
I had pasta.
What did you eat?
I had a chicken sandwich.
zh: 我吃了一个鸡肉三明治。
zh_hant: 我吃了一個雞肉三明治。

text: Well, today's episode is all about restaurants and food.
zh: 好，今天这期节目讲的全是餐馆和食物。
zh_hant: 好，今天這期節目講的全是餐館和食物。

text: Great.
I love it when we talk about food.
zh: 我最喜欢我们聊食物了。
zh_hant: 我最喜歡我們聊食物了。

text: Me too.
Neil, do you go to restaurants often?
Not that often.
Maybe when I meet some friends.
zh: 可能和朋友见面的时候会去。
zh_hant: 可能和朋友見面的時候會去。

text: How about you?
Do you go to restaurants often?
No, I don't go often.
Probably once a month.
OK.
And when you go to a restaurant,
what's your favourite part of eating there?
zh: 你最喜欢在那吃饭的哪一点？
zh_hant: 你最喜歡在那吃飯的哪一點？

text: I like to be around lots of people.
I really love it when a restaurant has a good atmosphere.
zh: 我特别喜欢餐馆有好的氛围。
zh_hant: 我特別喜歡餐館有好的氛圍。

text: I love spending time with friends.
zh: 我喜欢和朋友一起度过时光。
zh_hant: 我喜歡和朋友一起度過時光。

text: What about you?
Why do you like eating in a restaurant?
zh: 你为什么喜欢在餐馆吃饭？
zh_hant: 你為什麼喜歡在餐館吃飯？

text: Well, I like to go to a restaurant
that serves food that I don't know how to cook.
zh: 做我不会做的菜的餐馆。
zh_hant: 做我不會做的菜的餐館。

text: Yeah, that's a good point.
So, restaurants with food from countries that I don't know
zh: 所以，就是那些来自我不太了解的国家的菜的餐馆，
zh_hant: 所以，就是那些來自我不太瞭解的國家的菜的餐館，

text: very well, or that are very different types of food to the food I make.
zh: 非常好，或者是跟我做的食物类型差别很大的食物。
zh_hant: 非常好，或者是跟我做的食物型別差別很大的食物。

text: It's really nice to eat out.
That means to eat not at your home,
because you don't have to make the food and you don't have to wash up.
zh: 因为你不用做饭，也不用洗碗。
zh_hant: 因為你不用做飯，也不用洗碗。

text: That's true, yes.
It's also nice to eat out for a special occasion,
zh: 在特殊场合出去吃饭也很好，
zh_hant: 在特殊場合出去吃飯也很好，

text: so like a birthday or a celebration.
Yes, and another special occasion could be something like Christmas,
zh: 对，另一个特殊场合可能是圣诞节之类的，
zh_hant: 對，另一個特殊場合可能是聖誕節之類的，

text: and we at BBC Learning English are eating out for that special occasion.
zh: 我们 BBC Learning English 团队正为这个特殊场合外出就餐。
zh_hant: 我們 BBC Learning English 團隊正為這個特殊場合外出就餐。

text: We're having a celebration, Aren't we?
Yes, every year we have a Christmas party, and we usually eat out in a restaurant.
zh: 对，我们每年都有圣诞派对，通常会在餐馆吃饭。
zh_hant: 對，我們每年都有聖誕派對，通常會在餐館吃飯。

text: So, Neil, you said you like eating out in lots of different types of restaurants.
zh: 那么，尼尔，你说过你喜欢在各种不同类型的餐厅里外出就餐。
zh_hant: 那麼，尼爾，你說過你喜歡在各種不同型別的餐廳裡外出就餐。

text: What do you usually order?
Well, I really like spicy food, like Indian curries,
zh: 嗯，我很喜欢辣的食物，比如印度咖喱，
zh_hant: 嗯，我很喜歡辣的食物，比如印度咖哩，

text: and I like fish,
so I like to get fish curry.
Mmm, that sounds delicious.
And we have a special way of ordering, don't we?
zh: 我们点菜有个特别的方法，对吧？
zh_hant: 我們點菜有個特別的方法，對吧？

text: What are some phrases we can use to order things in restaurants?
zh: 在餐馆点菜可以用哪些短语？
zh_hant: 在餐館點菜可以用哪些短語？

text: Yeah, so we can say, I'll have the fish curry.
zh: 好，我们可以说：我要咖喱鱼。
zh_hant: 好，我們可以說：我要咖哩魚。

text: I'll have the fish curry, please.
Yes, and you can also say, can I have the fish curry, please, as well.
zh: 对，你也可以说：请问能给我咖喱鱼吗？
zh_hant: 對，你也可以說：請問能給我咖哩魚嗎？

text: OK, Georgie,
what do you usually order in a restaurant?
I also usually get the fish or a risotto.
zh: 我也常点鱼或者意式烩饭。
zh_hant: 我也常點魚或者意式燴飯。

text: Ah, OK.
So, let's say we are in a restaurant now.
zh: 那假设我们现在在一家餐馆里。
zh_hant: 那假設我們現在在一家餐館裡。

text: I'm the waiter.
I say to you, are you ready to order?
zh: 我对你说：您准备好点菜了吗？
zh_hant: 我對你說：您準備好點菜了嗎？

text: Yes, I am.
And what would you like?
Can I get the risotto, please?
zh: 请问能给我意式烩饭吗？
zh_hant: 請問能給我意式燴飯嗎？

text: Yes, of course.
So, we can also say, can I get the risotto,
zh: 所以，我们也可以说：能给我意式烩饭吗，
zh_hant: 所以，我們也可以說：能給我意式燴飯嗎，

text: as well as, can I have the risotto?
zh: 以及：能给我意式烩饭吗？
zh_hant: 以及：能給我意式燴飯嗎？

text: And notice that we say the risotto, not a risotto.
zh: 注意我们说the risotto，而不是a risotto。
zh_hant: 注意我們說the risotto，而不是a risotto。

text: That's right.
Let's recap the language we learned during the conversation.
zh: 我们来回顾一下对话中学到的语言。
zh_hant: 我們來回顧一下對話中學到的語言。

text: We had eat out, which means eat a meal
zh: 我们学了eat out，意思是在餐馆
zh_hant: 我們學了eat out，意思是在餐館

text: at a restaurant rather than at home.
Special occasion – a birthday, anniversary
or other reason to celebrate.
And we learned that when we order in a restaurant,
zh: 我们还学到，在餐馆点菜时，
zh_hant: 我們還學到，在餐館點菜時，

text: we usually say, I'll have the… something, fish, chicken, risotto.
zh: 我们通常说：I'll have the……某样东西，鱼、鸡肉、意式烩饭。
zh_hant: 我們通常說：I'll have the……某樣東西，魚、雞肉、意式燴飯。

text: Or can I get the… and what you want to order.
zh: 或者说：Can I get the……加上你想点的东西。
zh_hant: 或者說：Can I get the……加上你想點的東西。

text: So, for example, when I eat at my favourite restaurant,
zh: 比如，我在最喜欢的餐馆吃饭时，
zh_hant: 比如，我在最喜歡的餐館吃飯時，

text: I always get the risotto.
Thanks for listening to Real Easy English.
zh: 感谢收听《真实简单英语》。
zh_hant: 感謝收聽《真實簡單英語》。

text: If you like restaurants,
you could try our drama series, The White Elephant,
zh: 可以试试我们的剧集《白象》，
zh_hant: 可以試試我們的劇集《白象》，

text: all about a busy restaurant kitchen.
zh: 讲的是一家忙碌的餐馆厨房。
zh_hant: 講的是一家忙碌的餐館廚房。

text: There's a link in the notes for this programme.
zh: 本期节目说明里有链接。
zh_hant: 本期節目說明裡有連結。

text: Next time on Real Easy English,
we're talking about clothes and fashion.
See you then.
Goodbye.
Bye.
